messages:
sophie.support: Escalating a Skyline Logistics autopay failure — multiple invoices declined this morning. Customer insists cards have funds. Need triage + repro steps.

ramon.payments: I see 4 failed charges in the last 40m. Two returned decline_code=insufficient_funds, two returned acs_challenge_timeout from the acquirer. :frown:

jie.eng: Can you drop the payment IDs and a sample request? I'll pull runtime traces.

sophie.support: IDs: pay_2026031701, pay_2026031702, pay_2026031703, pay_2026031704. Customer on a call rn.

payments-bot: webhook: pay_2026031701 failed -> decline_code: insufficient_funds, acquirer: euro-pay, environment: prod, attempt: 1

ramon.payments: Pasted a snippet from the runtime logs for pay_2026031703 (3DS flow):

```
2026-03-17T08:14:12Z INFO  request id=req-9a3fa init 3DS redirect to ACS
2026-03-17T08:14:28Z WARN  acs session abc123: no nonce returned from ACS -> treating as timeout
2026-03-17T08:14:30Z ERROR upstream timeout on gateway euro-pay (502) while proxying ACS callback
2026-03-17T08:14:30Z INFO  retrying payment (idempotency-key: pay_2026031703-retry-1)
```

ramon.payments: The 502 on the gateway retry looks correlated with the acs timeout — we may be racing the 3DS window.

ana.fraud: (typo name corrected) ana.fraud: For the two insufficient_funds declines I'm seeing fraud_score=82 and CVV_mismatch flagged by the acquirer. Velocity rule also triggered (3 attempts in < 1m). Could be a combined signal: low balance + automated retry.

maria.success: Customer notes they run an internal payroll sweep at 07:59 UTC which could leave a short window of low balances. They're frustrated because autopay is marked as successful in our UI sometimes and then rolls back. Need a clear mitigation to propose.

jie.eng: Quick repro for infra: use sandbox with a 3DS-required card. Steps we used:
1) POST /v1/payments with card 4000000000003026 and header X-Env: prod-sandbox
2) follow the 3DS redirect URL returned by our runtime
3) delay the ACS POST by >12s to simulate slow ACS (you can `sleep 13` before returning)
Observe: runtime logs an ACS nonce miss then gateway upstream 502 on retry.

Example curl to simulate (sandbox):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/payments \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" \
  -d '{"amount": 5000, "currency":"EUR", "card_number":"4000000000003026", "exp_month":12, "exp_year":2030, "cvc":"123"}'
```

ramon.payments: Immediate mitigation options:
- Short-term: disable aggressive autopay retry for customers with consecutive failures within 5m (reduce velocity triggers).
- Mid-term: increase acquirer/ACS proxy timeout to 15s for 3DS redirects and add clearer idempotency on retries.
- Notify merchants when we detect low balance + high fraud_score so they can delay sweep or use alternate payment method.

ana.fraud: ana.fraud: Also recommend turning on the acquirer CVV soft-decline path where supported (so we surface a softer decline reason to merchant instead of hard block).

sophie.support: Action items:
- @jie.eng open ENG-INC-1245 (increase acquirer timeout + retry backoff) — assigned to jie.
- @ramon.payments add a short-term flag to throttle autopay retries for the Skyline tenant — assigned to ramon.
- @ana.fraud add merchant notification template and check acquirer CVV soft-decline flag — assigned to ana.
- Support to send interim note to customer explaining timing risk around payroll sweep.

jie.eng: I started ENG-INC-1245 and attached the logs. ETA for a safe timeout bump + deploy: ~4 hours. Will also add additional logging for ACS nonce to help root cause.

ramon.payments: I'll push a tenant-scoped autopay throttle in the next 2 hours (feature flagged).

maria.success: Thanks — customer wants a clear rollback plan if we see double-charges. Please document the idempotency behavior in the ticket.

sophie.support: Good plan. I'll send the customer the interim mitigation and set a follow-up in 2 hours. :thumbsup:

payments-bot: note: follow-up reminder set for 1718205834 (2h)

jie.eng: FYI logs we found while debugging to share with infra (trimmed):
`req=req-9a3fa, acquirer=euro-pay, acs_session=abc123, acs_nonce=null, upstream_status=502, retries=1`

ana.fraud: ana.fraud: leaving a comment in the fraud playbook about combined low-balance + CVV mismatch signals.

ramon.payments: Will monitor and report back in thread. If anyone reproduces a full success on the same card during the payroll sweep window, call it out here.

sophie.support: Closing loop for now — assigned owners and steps. If anything new appears, drop it here and I'll reopen escalation.
